interpretation.existing_design: Separating or combining model and effort controls, and automatic selection, already exist as product patterns. These product documents are interface evidence, not prior empirical papers.
interpretation.correction: Do not present separate setting categories or adaptive selection alone as the research's novelty. Specific Eco semantic organization and user-understood tradeoffs remain a contribution candidate.
interpretation.refined_question: When an environmental Eco goal is added to services that already expose model/effort/automatic choice, what function do users infer and what compromises will they accept?
interpretation.recommended_stage0: Comparative interface review of Gemini Apps, ChatGPT Work and Claude before the comprehension pilot; record axes, hierarchy, wording of speed/quality/usage/environment, defaults, client, language, plan and observation date.
interpretation.experimental_scope: Use review to justify Eco placement/descriptions and test current six-option concept. Keep common tasks/authored responses in neutral prototype; avoid attributing brand/model-performance differences to Eco framing.
interpretation.resources: UI efficiency or provider descriptions do not independently measure ecological savings; environmental measurement remains outside first prototype study.

status: Preliminary official-document comparison plus user-provided screenshots; not a completed standardized signed-in UI audit across all providers.
